set.body:
Raised by independent review after the Epic 2 suite run.

The two 50k topology gates added for the coordinate-lookup fix are correct and they pass:

  EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS=true  ->  support-index: 47 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip

But in a default run they skip:

  testthat::test_local()  ->  1770 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn, 2 SKIP
    - "a 50k-volume topology builds without quadratic storage"      (test-support-index.R:171)
    - "a 50k-coordinate topology uses vectorized cell lookup"        (test-support-index.R:185)

grep for EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS across the repo returns only the two skip() guards that read it. Nothing sets it: no .github, no Makefile, no CI configuration of any kind, no helper, no Rbuildignore hook. The variable is referenced exclusively by the code that skips on it.

Consequence

The scale evidence exists but is unreachable by any automated run, including R CMD check. It executes only when a human remembers an undocumented environment variable. That matters more than a normal skipped test because:

- The O(p x n_groups) regression these gates were written for was invisible until it was measured; a silent skip restores exactly that blind spot.
- Epic 1 acceptance requires a 50-60k fixture to build without quadratic-in-p allocation.
- Epic 8 stakes a 4 GiB / 30 min go/no-go on scale evidence, and per bd-01KZXC3BDCR4E6SF0TGAN37XQ1 that gate now also needs the evaluation-edge multiplicity. If the only scale tests never run, Epic 9 would close the statistical 0.1 gate on evidence that was skipped.

Suggested fix, cheapest first

- Document the variable in the test file header and in the Epic 8 benchmark instructions so it is at least discoverable.
- Add a minimal CI workflow that runs the suite twice, once with EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS=true, so the gate is enforced rather than available.
- Make Epic 9 acceptance require a recorded scale-enabled run, not merely a clean default suite.

Not a defect in the gates themselves - they are well written and they pass. The gap is that nothing causes them to run.
set.title: Scale gates are correct but unreachable: no CI or runner ever sets EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS
